messages:
ian_support: Hey team — BrightLane reporting they can't see Billing tab or models in console after this morning's RBAC refactor. tenant: brightlane-prod. Can someone take?

julia_sec: I'm on it. Any repro steps / user email?

ian_support: They say org-admins can view but billing-admins get 403s. example user: alice@brightlane.com. Console log snippet: `403: forbidden - roles missing: billing.viewer`

alex_infra: Seeing related failures in role-service logs. Post-refactor we removed transitive inheritance for 'billing.*' roles. That could be it. Pinging @deploy-bot for rollout id.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback requested by @alex_infra: rollback rbac-refactor v2 -> initiating. ETA ~4m

maria_eng: Can we do a targeted patch instead of full rollback? If inheritance semantics are required for some orgs we can reintroduce an `inherit_billing_roles` flag and backfill bindings.

julia_sec: For customer impact timeline we should restore access quickly. Rollback is safe. Alex, after rollback can you run `rbac-tool backfill --org brightlane-prod --role billing.viewer` and post audit id.

alex_infra: Rollback started. logs: `rbac-service: rollback v2 -> v1 triggered by alex_infra`. Backfill queued.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-20-001 severity=high owners=@alex_infra,@julia_sec,@maria_eng

ian_support: BrightLane confirms billing tab is visible again. alice@brightlane.com says models are listed. Thanks.

maria_eng: I'll open PR to add flag + unit tests and create migration job with dry-run. Also will add an audit alert if role inheritance drops more than 1% of orgs.

julia_sec: Assigning postmortem: sec/julia, infra/alex, eng/maria. Need audit logs + KMS access check: ensure service-account used by rbac-service still has kms.decrypt for customer key (brightlane-kms).

alex_infra: KMS check OK — service account has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on brightlane-kms. Audit id: audit-98231. Closing incident once postmortem posted.

ian_support: Thanks all. I'll update the support ticket and notify customer. :white_check_mark:
